meta.question: Reviewer concern #1/#2: are the cascade (dnaphysics) and chemistry (chem6) oracles the same physics list (no seam)? And should the empirical SIGMA_EXC_SCALE=0.39 be replaced by the real excitation cross section?
meta.method: Read the Geant4 11.3 source: dnaphysics/PhysicsList.cc, chem6/PhysicsList.cc, G4EmDNAPhysics_option2.cc, G4EmDNABuilder::ConstructDNAElectronPhysics. Then swapped the excitation data Emfietzoglou->Born in the convert tool, set SIGMA_EXC_SCALE=1.0, regenerated, and revalidated CSDA (8 energies) + cascade + chemistry + SSB + energy conservation.

audit.seam: NONE — both oracles use the SAME track-structure physics list, option2. Cascade and chemistry are validated against one consistent reference.
audit.option2_electron_models: For opt=2 the Emfietzoglou energy limit emaxE=0 (only opt=4 sets it to 10 keV), so the Emfietzoglou block is never registered. option2 uses G4DNABornIonisationModel + G4DNABornExcitationModel across the whole range. The reference excitation is BORN, not Emfietzoglou.
audit.implication: SIGMA_EXC_SCALE=0.39 was approximating Born by flat-scaling Emfietzoglou. But Emf/Born is energy-dependent (~2.5x at keV, ~10x at ~10 eV), so a flat 0.39 left low-energy secondaries over-excited ~4x vs Born — the cause of the residual cascade deficit AND the chronic sub-keV CSDA deficit.

chemistry_rms_vs_chem6.note: flat; G(H) overshoot 1.055->0.939x fixed, G(eaq) 0.899->0.937x better, OH/H2/H2O2 slightly lower

ssb_ratio.note: drifted above PARTRAC 2-3 band — P_indirect was calibrated for the old physics; re-calibration follow-up

headline: option2 uses Born excitation; switching to the real Born XS (removing the SIGMA_EXC_SCALE fudge entirely) CLOSES the chronic sub-keV CSDA deficit (100eV 0.782->0.956x, all 8 energies now 0.956-1.005x), slightly improves the cascade (0.942x), keeps chemistry flat (7.0%, G(H) overshoot fixed), and makes the excitation PARAMETER-FREE and exactly matched to the reference physics list.
addresses_reviewer: #1 (no seam — both oracles are option2), #2 (real Born XS, σ_exc fudge removed), #3 (sub-keV CSDA closed — the low-E physics where Geant4-DNA matters most).
followup: SSB ratio drifted to 3.26 (P_indirect calibrated for old physics) — re-center the calibrated fit.
status: pass — adopted v0.7.0; excitation now parameter-free Born, matched to option2
